scientific_integrity: The frontier follows from a one-line exactness budget inequality and an explicit equality construction. Primary-source comparison separates the new finite-grid maximin floor from the source paper's existence, smoothness, positivity, domination, asymptotic convergence, and already-noted lattice obstruction.
scientific_limitations: Tie-free conformal rank grid; exact e-variable calibration at one prespecified level; worst-rank multiplicative floor only. The extremal two-level grid calibrator is not smooth or invertible, and no claim is made about alternative-distribution log-growth or aggregation optimality.
title: Sharp finite-sample anti-collapse frontier for set-preserving conformal e-calibration
